summary: Acquittal by trial court overturned on appeal; High Court convicted appellants under IPC 302/34; Supreme Court upheld High Court's reappraisal of evidence; minor witness inconsistencies insufficient to discard testimony; medical evidence gaps addressed; motive established via property dispute; eyewitness credibility affirmed; life sentence with fine imposed.
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; High Court conviction upheld; life imprisonment with Rs.5000 fine each confirmed.
